question: What chapter number and subject does this colophon assign to the dance-guardian embryo section in Kālottara?
premises: kālottare locates the statement in Kālottara
nṛttapālagarbhapaṭalaḥ names the dance-guardian embryo chapter
inference: This verse colophons the dance-guardian embryo chapter as the fifty-sixth chapter in Kālottara.
uncertainties: whether ṣaṭpañcāśat functions as cardinal or ordinal here
exact chapter boundary in this witness remains unverified
plain_english: Thus, in Kālottara, the chapter on the embryo-characteristics of the dance-guardian is the fifty-sixth.
